Ms. Chaitali Bhute, Advocate for the non-applicant No.2.

Coram: Mrs.Vrushali V. Joshi, J.
Dated: 6.10.2025.

The applicant is arrested in Crime No.342/2024 for the offence punishable under Section 376 of the
Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 and 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2.  It is the case of prosecution that the victim, who is mentally disabled, was found pregnant and her mother took her to hospital.
The fetus was aborted.
Initially F.I.R. was registered against unknown person.

Thereafter the statement of victim was recorded and she has told that the applicant had committed sexual assault and thereafter DNA test was conducted.
3.
The learned Advocate for the applicant states that applicant is in jail since 4.4.2024.
The DNA report is not matching to the fetus which shows that the applicant is not involved in said offence.
Hence, prayed to release the applicant on bail.
4. The learned A.P.P. opposed the application stating that the victim has stated about the act committed by the applicant.
She is 65% disabled.
She has given her statement and mentioned the name of this applicant.
Hence, prayed to reject the application.
5. The learned Advocate for the non-applicant No.2 has stated that the statement of applicant was recorded in presence of 2 ba710.2025.odt Psychologist in Rehabilitation Centre.
She has mentioned the name of this applicant and by gesture narrated the act of accused.

As the offence is serious,
prayed to reject the application.

6. Heard both sides and perused the record.
7.
The victim is mentally disabled.
On her statement only the offence is registered.
From DNA report it appears that the applicant is not biological father of said fetus.

i) Applicant- Sadare Alam S/o Nasiuddin Alam be released on bail in Crime No.342/2024, registered with Police Station M.I.D.C., Nagpur for the offence punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 and 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, on his furnishing P.R.
